第一天入队整编·政治扎根·作风定型

清晨六点，起床号准时响起。

王建新从床上弹起来，用了不到三分钟就把被子叠成了豆腐块——虽然比不上老兵，但棱角已经出来了。他穿上训练服，扎好武装带，对着镜子整了整军容，然后跑步到操场集合。

一排的士兵们已经站好了，三十多个人，齐刷刷的，像一排白杨树。孙排长站在队列前面，手里拿着花名册。看见王建新跑过来，他点了点头，指了指队列最右边：“王排长，站这儿。”

王建新站进队列，腰板挺直，目视前方。

今天是开训第一天。全连在操场集合，连长做了开训动员讲话，讲了这次集训的意义和目的。然后是光荣传统教育——指导员讲了一连的光荣历史，从抗日战争讲到解放战争，从解放战争讲到抗美援朝。王建新听得认真，记在心里。

上午剩下的时间学习内务条令、纪律作风、军容风纪、营房正规化养成。王建新坐在士兵中间，听指导员一条一条地讲，该记的记，该背的背。他脑子好使，听一遍就记住了。

下午是全排人员摸底和体能基础测试。五公里越野、俯卧撑、仰卧起坐，三项连着来。

五公里越野，王建新跑得很轻松。他刻意收着速度，跟在第一梯队后面，不快不慢，刚好跑进优秀线。俯卧撑一口气做了一百二十个，仰卧起坐做了一百五十个。孙排长看着他的成绩，眼睛都瞪大了，但没说什么。

晚上是步枪日常擦拭、武器保管、军械安全规矩。王建新对五六半已经很熟悉了，但还是认真地听，认真地学。擦枪、验枪、挂枪，每一个动作都按规范来，不打折扣。

最后是排建制分工、哨位轮换、值班排长职责学习。孙排长把排里的情况详细讲了一遍，哪个班是尖刀班，哪个兵是神枪手，哪个兵体能最好，王建新都记在心里。

熄灯号响起，王建新躺在床上，终于体验了一下真正的士兵生活是什么样的。然后进入空间继续修炼，并给大毛它们喂了一些肉食。感觉时间差不多了，便出了空间，躺在床上。

“第一天，还行。”他翻了个身，闭上了眼睛。

第二天队列指挥·口令养成·带兵基本功

天还没亮，王建新就醒了。

今天学的是制式队列：立正稍息、转法、齐步正步跑步、队形变换。这些都是当兵的基本功，看着简单，做起来难。王建新以前没练过，一开始走得别扭，孙排长在旁边纠正了几回。

“王排长，脚尖分开六十度！腰板挺直！下巴微收！”

王建新调整了姿势，站得笔直。队列动作他学得快，走了几遍就找到感觉了。齐步走的时候，手臂摆得跟老兵一样标准；正步走的时候，踢腿带风，落地砸坑。

孙排长看着他，眼神从担忧变成了满意。

下午是排长带队口令、集合整队、出入列、报告词全套规范。王建新站在排头，面向全排士兵，练习下达口令。

“立正——！向右看——齐！向前——看！”

口令要干脆利落，不能拖泥带水。王建新的声音洪亮，穿透力强，一嗓子喊出去，整个操场都能听见。士兵们听到口令，动作整齐划一，刷刷刷地就位。

然后是单独带队组训，指挥一班、二班、三班协同队列。王建新站在队列前面，口令一个接一个，指挥三个班变换队形。一开始有点生疏，但几遍下来就熟练了。

晚上是作风纪律讲评和一日生活制度熟记。孙排长把白天训练中的问题一条一条地讲，哪个兵队列动作不标准，哪个兵军容不整，都点了出来。王建新作为排长，也跟着听，跟着记。

第三天基础军事体能·野战耐力强化

今天的训练强度上来了。

早上先来一个徒手五公里。王建新还是收着跑，跟在第一梯队后面，不快不慢，全程保持匀速。跑完了，呼吸平稳，连汗都没出多少。旁边的士兵一个个气喘吁吁，弯着腰大口大口地喘气。

然后是负重干粮装具越野长跑。背上背包，挎上水壶，扛着枪，跑十公里。王建新背着装具，感觉跟没背一样——这点重量对他来说跟没有似的。但他不能表现得太轻松，故意喘了几口气，让自己看起来像是用了全力。

剩下的时间是单杠双杠基础器械和腰腹腿部力量训练。单杠卷身上，王建新一口气做了二十个，看得旁边的士兵目瞪口呆。双杠臂屈伸，做了三十个。孙排长走过来，拍了拍他的肩膀，竖起了一个大拇指。

下午是匍匐前进、障碍越野、山林地形适应跑。匍匐前进分低姿、侧姿、高姿，王建新趴在泥地里，蹭蹭蹭地往前爬，速度比老兵还快。障碍越野更不用说了，翻墙、过独木桥、钻铁丝网、跳深坑，他像一阵风一样冲过去，全程没磕没碰。

孙排长站在终点，看着秒表，半天没说话。过了好一会儿，他才说了一句：“王排长，你是不是以前练过？”

王建新笑了笑：“练过一点。”

晚上是野外长途徒步行军耐力训练和排集体编组拉练。全排背着装具，在夜色中行军二十公里。王建新走在队伍中间，观察着每个士兵的状态，哪个掉队了，哪个背包松了，他都看在眼里，及时提醒。

On the first day of joining the team, reorganization, political roots, and style shaping

At six o'clock in the morning, the wake-up call sounded on time.

Wang Jianxin jumped up from the bed and folded the quilt into tofu pieces in less than three minutes - although it was not as good as the veterans, the edges were already there.He put on his training uniform, put on his armed belt, adjusted his military appearance in front of the mirror, and then ran to the playground to assemble.

A row of soldiers had already stood, more than thirty of them, standing together like a row of poplar trees.Platoon leader Sun stood in front of the queue, holding the roster in his hand.Seeing Wang Jianxin running over, he nodded and pointed to the far right of the queue: "Platoon Leader Wang, stand here."

Wang Jianxin stood in the queue, back straight and looking straight ahead.

Today is the first day of training.The whole company gathered in the playground, and the company commander gave a mobilization speech to start the training, explaining the significance and purpose of this training.Then came the glorious traditional education - the instructor talked about the glorious history of Yilian, from the War of Resistance Against Japan to the War of Liberation, and from the War of Liberation to the War of Resisting U.S. Aggression and Aiding Korea.Wang Jianxin listened carefully and took it to heart.

The rest of the morning was spent studying internal regulations, discipline and style, military ethics, and barracks standardization.Wang Jianxin sat among the soldiers and listened to the instructor's instructions one by one, memorizing what should be memorized and memorizing what should be memorized.He has a good brain and remembers everything after listening to it once.

In the afternoon, the whole platoon will have a thorough understanding and basic physical fitness test.Five kilometers of cross-country, push-ups, and sit-ups, all three in a row.

Wang Jianxin ran the five-kilometer cross-country easily.He deliberately slowed down and followed the first echelon, neither too fast nor too slow, just running into the excellent line.I did 120 push-ups and 150 sit-ups in one breath.Platoon Leader Sun's eyes widened when he looked at his results, but he didn't say anything.

In the evening, there are daily rifle cleaning, weapon storage, and ordnance safety rules.Wang Jianxin was already very familiar with Wuliuban, but he still listened carefully and studied seriously.Cleaning the gun, inspecting the gun, hanging the gun, every action is carried out according to the specifications without compromise.

Finally, there is the division of labor in the platoon structure, rotation of sentry positions, and learning of the duties of the platoon leader on duty.Platoon Leader Sun gave a detailed account of the situation in the platoon. Wang Jianxin kept it all in mind as to which squad was the sharp knife squad, which soldier was the sharpshooter, and which soldier had the best physical fitness.

When the lights-out signal sounded, Wang Jianxin lay on the bed and finally experienced what a real soldier's life was like.Then he entered the space to continue practicing and fed Da Mao and the others some meat.Feeling that the time was almost up, I left the space and lay on the bed.

"The first day, it's okay." He turned over and closed his eyes.

The second day: Queue command·Code development·Basic skills of leading troops

Wang Jianxin woke up before dawn.

What I learned today was the standard formation: standing at attention, taking a breath, turning, running in unison, and changing formations.These are the basic skills of being a soldier. They look simple but are difficult to do.Wang Jianxin had never practiced before, and he walked awkwardly at first. Platoon Leader Sun corrected him several times.

"Platoon Commander Wang, point your toes 60 degrees apart! Keep your back straight! Tuck your chin slightly!"

Wang Jianxin adjusted his posture and stood up straight.He learned the queue movements quickly and got the feel for it after doing it a few times.When walking in unison, swing your arms as standard as a veteran; when walking forward, kick your legs to catch the wind, and hit the ground when you hit the ground.

Platoon Leader Sun looked at him, his eyes changing from worry to satisfaction.

In the afternoon, the platoon leader gave instructions for leading the team, assembling the team, entering and exiting the queue, and a complete set of reporting instructions.Wang Jianxin stood at the front of the row, facing the entire platoon of soldiers, practicing giving commands.

"Stand at attention——! Look to the right——Qi! Look forward——!"

The password should be crisp and concise, not sloppy.Wang Jianxin's voice was loud and penetrating, and he could be heard throughout the playground when he shouted out.When the soldiers heard the command, they moved uniformly and got into position.

Then he leads the team training alone and directs the first, second and third classes to coordinate the formation.Wang Jianxin stood in front of the queue, commanding the three squads to change their formations one after another.It was a bit unfamiliar at first, but after a few times I became proficient.

In the evening, there is a review of work style and discipline and memorization of the daily life system.Platoon leader Sun explained the problems in the day's training one by one, pointing out which soldiers' movements were not standard and which soldiers were not in good shape.As the platoon leader, Wang Jianxin also listened and took notes.

The third day of basic military physical fitness and field endurance strengthening

Today's training intensity is up.

Start with a five-kilometer walk in the morning.Wang Jianxin still kept running and followed the first echelon, neither too fast nor too slow, keeping a constant speed throughout the process.After running, my breathing was steady and I didn’t even sweat much.The soldiers next to him were panting, bending over and gasping for air.

Then there is the cross-country long-distance run with heavy-duty dry food equipment.Put on a backpack, a water bottle, a gun, and run ten kilometers.Wang Jianxin is carrying the equipment on his back, and it feels like he is not carrying it - the weight is as if it is nothing to him.But he couldn't act too relaxed, and deliberately took a few breaths to make it look like he was using all his strength.

The remaining time is spent on basic equipment such as horizontal and parallel bars and strength training for the waist, abdomen and legs.Wang Jianxin did twenty horizontal bar rolls at one go, leaving the soldiers next to him stunned.Parallel bar arm extensions, thirty reps.Platoon leader Sun came over, patted him on the shoulder and gave him a thumbs up.

In the afternoon, there was crawling, obstacle course, and mountain and forest terrain adaptation running.Creeping forward can be divided into low posture, side posture, and high posture. Wang Jianxin lay on the mud and crawled forward faster than the veteran.Not to mention the obstacle course, climbing over walls, crossing single-plank bridges, drilling through barbed wire fences, and jumping into deep pits, he rushed through them like a gust of wind without making a single bump in the process.

Platoon leader Sun stood at the finish line, looking at the stopwatch, and said nothing for a long time.After a while, he finally said: "Platoon Leader Wang, have you practiced before?"

Wang Jianxin smiled: "I have practiced a little."

In the evening, there is endurance training for long-distance hiking and marching in the wild and platoon group training.The whole platoon marched twenty kilometers in the dark with equipment on their backs.Wang Jianxin walked in the middle of the team, observing the status of each soldier. He saw which one fell behind or whose backpack was loose, and reminded him in time.
